title: Section homology detects Ext cocycle equality
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $F$ an abelian sheaf, $I$ an injective resolution, and $q\geq0$. Let $a,b:\mathbf Z_X\to I^q$ be cocycles and $z,w$ cycles of $A=\Gamma(X,I^\bullet)$ [def-pc-abelian-cech-comparison-construction], whose section values under the constant-sheaf adjunction evaluated at $1$ are respectively $iCycles(z),iCycles(w)$. If $homology\pi(z)=homology\pi(w)$, then $extMk_I(a)=extMk_I(b)$. This uses no open family or comparison map.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, augmentation construction and omitted coefficient functoriality; Tag 01FD comparison diagram; explicit formal verification using the Mathlib APIs named in the proof

proof.text: In each degree form the additive equivalence e from morphisms out of the constant integral sheaf to sections, by the additive constant-sheaf adjunction followed by uliftZMultiplesAddEquiv. Its naturality commutes with differentials. In degree zero the homology projection from cycles is an isomorphism, so the two section values coincide and injectivity of e gives a=b.

In degree n+1 the toCycles/homology projection sequence is exact because homology is its cokernel. Apply ab_exact_iff to z-w to get a section t with toCycles(t)=z-w. Compose with iCycles to identify d(t)=e(a)-e(b). Differential naturality and injectivity of e show that the inverse image of t is a morphism whose differential equals a-b. Apply extMk_eq_zero_iff to that boundary and sub_extMk to conclude.

proof_origin.place: Augmentation construction; explicit coefficient-functoriality and Ext/section verification by N2

lean.statement:
theorem abelianCech_ext_section_injective
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (a b : (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)) ⟶ I.cocomplex.X q)
    (ha : a ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
    (hb : b ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0)
    (z w : (abelianCechSections I).cycles q)
    (hz : ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      isTerminalTop).homEquiv _ _ a) (ULift.up 1) =
        (abelianCechSections I).iCycles q z)
    (hw : ((constantSheafAdj (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      isTerminalTop).homEquiv _ _ b) (ULift.up 1) =
        (abelianCechSections I).iCycles q w)
    (h : (abelianCechSections I).homologyπ q z =
      (abelianCechSections I).homologyπ q w) :
    I.extMk a (q + 1) rfl ha = I.extMk b (q + 1) rfl hb
